notes: Fixed duplicate image position controls. Image backgrounds had two competing sets of Scale / X / Y sliders — an old one buried in the 'Choose a background' panel (which used the outdated crop model and was hard to find) plus the new 'Image framing' panel. They wrote to the same values and fought each other, so repositioning didn't stick and the image still looked cropped. Removed the old buried set; the single 'Image framing' panel at the top is now the one source of truth, using the correct pan model. Ken Burns stays in the image panel.
